lines.en: Every step of mine lands heavy.

lines.zh: 我走过蕨地，草全伏下去。
lines.en: I cross the fernland and the ferns lie flat.
I walk head low, sniffing as I go.

lines.zh: 两条后腿撑起这具身子。
lines.en: Two hind legs carry this body.
I stride along the river.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴横在身后配平。
lines.en: My tail rides behind for balance.
I press toward the trees.

lines.zh: 走一步，地面就闷响一下。
lines.en: Each step lands with a muffled thud.
I go around the big tree's roots.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，挤进两树之间。
lines.en: I turn sideways between two trees.
I stride toward where the noise came from.

lines.zh: 我不快，可每一步都算数。
lines.en: I am not fast, but every step counts.
I raise my head and look far off.
I follow old tracks back.

lines.zh: 我的下颚半张着，牙露在外。
lines.en: My jaw hangs half open with teeth showing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，风把气味送来。
lines.en: I hold still and the wind brings scents.
I tilt my head to listen to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了一丛蕨。
lines.en: My shadow covers a clump of ferns.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚往前挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift one foot forward.
There is heat in my breath.

lines.zh: 远处有食草的家伙，我没动。
lines.en: Grazers are far off and I do not move.
I lift my head and test the wind.
I watch that wood a while.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴轻轻扫了一下。
lines.en: I sweep my tail once.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一个够近的距离。
lines.en: I wait for enough closeness.
I lower myself and come closer.
I sniff you to judge.
My teeth are right before you.
You retreat; I do not follow.
I tilt my head, one eye on you.
Your hands are moving, and I see them.

lines.zh: 你这么站着，倒是有点意思。
lines.en: Standing like that is a little interesting.

lines.zh: 你在下面站着，正合我意。
lines.en: Standing down there suits me just fine.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，也退了半步。
lines.en: I roar and give half a step too.

lines.zh: 这一下在我皮上开了口。
lines.en: That opens a cut on my hide.
I shake my head and throw off the blood.
The more it hurts, the harder I bite.
I sink my body and lower my weight.
I grit my teeth and stay standing.

lines.zh: 我喘了几口，热气喷出来。
lines.en: I pant a few breaths of hot air.

lines.zh: 这个伤，我记得是谁给的。
lines.en: I remember who gave me this wound.
I have it in my eye.
The hide is cut; I can still run you down.

lines.zh: 肉味一飘来，我的头就转过去。
lines.en: The smell of meat turns my head.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我一口就没了。
lines.en: You lift it and it is gone in one bite.
That is too little.

lines.zh: 我朝你走近，脚步压得很轻。
lines.en: I come closer with a light tread.
I lower my head to sniff your hand.

lines.zh: 你手别动，我不一定收得住。
lines.en: Hold still; I may not be able to stop.
I chew twice and swallow.
What I want is something big.
The meat smell is strong; I lick my teeth.
That is only enough to start.

lines.zh: 你撞上我小腿，我连晃都没晃。
lines.en: You hit my shin and I do not even sway.

lines.zh: 我肩一送，你便让开半步。
lines.en: One push of my shoulder and you give half a step.
This weight does not shove.
I look down with my teeth showing.
You retreat smartly, and that is right.
I lift a foot to a new stance.
The impact booms in my chest.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的腿走，太近了。
lines.en: Walking against my leg is too close.
I turn my body across to block.
We circle each other.
It lowers its head to my neck.
We press our bodies together.
I push a low branch aside for it.
It turns and I take half a step after it.
We lie abreast in the shade.
My head rests on its back.
It calls and I answer.
We walk around this patch of grass.
Neither of us is hurrying.
I take a big piece in my jaws.
I take the chunk of meat and shake it twice.
This bite went through.
I swallow it whole.
Too small; I cannot be bothered.
I hold it beneath one foot.
I taste it and spit it out.
My mouth is full of blood taste.
This piece I keep for later.
The moment it moves, I see it.
I drop my head and aim at it.
I take one stride out.
I have it stared dead.
My teeth click together.
It runs that way, and there is no way there.
I begin the chase and do not mean to stop.
I cut toward its flank.
It has stepped into my ground.
I growl and the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 它的胸腹已经起伏不匀。
lines.en: Its chest is already heaving unevenly.
Two more steps is enough.
It has not seen where I am.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，步子越迈越大。
lines.en: I follow it with longer strides.
It turns and I cut the corner.
I hold its rear quarter.
It tries to shake me, and cannot.

lines.zh: 我算它的速度，再压上去。
lines.en: I measure its speed and close.
My breathing stays even.

lines.zh: 它每一次回头，我都记着。
lines.en: I mark each time it looks back.
It dives into the trees, which is better.
It is slowing.
One more beat and I drive.

lines.zh: 它的影子已经在我的影子边上。
lines.en: Its shadow is already at the edge of mine.
It will run into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我不急，猎物的力气先耗尽。
lines.en: No hurry. The quarry tires first.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙陷进去了。
lines.en: I bite down and my teeth sink in.
I butt with my head.

lines.zh: 一只脚踩下去，把地面压裂。
lines.en: One foot comes down and cracks the ground.
I knock it over.
That bite tears a piece off.

lines.zh: 它咬我，我甩头把它带倒。
lines.en: It bites and I shake my head to throw it down.
I clamp its shoulder again.
I press it into the ground.
I pant with something still in my mouth.
That one took all my strength.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，血从嘴边滴下。
lines.en: I lift my head and blood drips from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫平了一片草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a patch of grass flat.
We can do this again if you like.

lines.zh: 我踏出林线，地面震了一下。
lines.en: I step out of the treeline and the ground jumps.
The smell of the Cretaceous is familiar.

lines.zh: 我一来，附近的活物都停了。
lines.en: The moment I arrive, all living things still.
I raise my head and sweep a look.
I snap a few dead branches.

lines.zh: 风把气味送来，我先记下。
lines.en: The wind brings scents; I note them first.
One sweep of my tail and I walk.
The ground here is flat and good for running.
My shadow stretches very long.
A river runs close by.

lines.zh: 我朝林子里最有味道的方向走。
lines.en: I head for the strongest scent in the wood.
A low growl comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向一边，又偏回来。
lines.en: I tilt my head aside and back.

lines.zh: 我落脚的地方草都断了。
lines.en: Grass snaps where I set down.
I lift a foot and move slowly.
It has not rained here for days.

lines.zh: 我开始朝有水声那边去。
lines.en: I start toward the sound of water.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，我翻滚着压灭。
lines.en: Fire sears my back and I roll to smother it.
I land too hard and my leg bones crack.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我猛地抬头。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 炸风把我推得侧移一步。
lines.en: The blast shifts me a step sideways.

lines.zh: 一支东西扎进我肩，我扭头去咬。
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder and I turn to bite it.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进骨头，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my bones and I shudder.

lines.zh: 饿得太久了，我的力气在退。
lines.en: Too long without food and my strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷顺着脊背下去，我四条腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning runs my spine and my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我这具身子直往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone and my bulk drops away.
